messages:
alex: FYI seeing DCGM exporter dropouts on a subset of GPU nodes in us-west1, dashboards show GPU_* metrics missing since ~10:05 UTC. node_exporter is up, but prometheus target dcgm-exporter/metrics shows 404 for some pods. kubectl shows some pods in CrashLoopBackOff on nodes labeled gpu:new-kernel.

maya: can you paste the pod logs? any image versions changed recently?

alex: logs from one failing pod:
```
E0322 10:07:12 main.go:85 error: failed to init NVML: NVML_LIBRARY_NOT_FOUND
E0322 10:07:12 main.go:86 error: nvidia-smi returned code 127
```
looks like the host libs not mounted on nodes that were provisioned from the new image.

jordan: we rolled a host image last night for the kernel patch. looks like the image build missed the DCGM / NVIDIA libs. those nodes are labeled `gpu:new-kernel` and are ~7 nodes.

sam: ok quick mitigation ideas: 1) patch daemonset to include an initContainer that checks for NVML and waits (retry), 2) roll pods away from the new-image nodes using nodeAffinity, 3) silence alert flapping by increasing the for: window.

maya: i can push a small rollout: set maxUnavailable=1 on the DaemonSet and add an initContainer that `test -e /usr/lib/nvidia` with retries. i will also update the prometheus alert to for: 5m so we avoid paging on transient provisioning gaps.

infra-bot: Deploy plan created: `dcgm-exporter-rollout-20260322` — runbook link: https://internal.redwood/devops/runbooks/dcgm-exporter

alex: testing initContainer snippet i'm going to apply (quick smoke):
```
initContainers:
- name: check-nvidia
  image: busybox
  command: ["/bin/sh","-c","for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do test -e /usr/lib/nvidia && exit 0; sleep 10; done; exit 1"]
```
This will cause pods on nodes without libs to fail the init and stay pending instead of CrashLoopBackOff, giving ops time to fix the host image.

jordan: also add nodeSelector `gpu=true` and a toleration for `node.kubernetes.io/not-ready`? probably not necessary, prefer using nodeAffinity to prefer stable hosts.

sam: alert tuning specifics: change prometheus rule `DCGMExporterDown` from `for: 1m` to `for: 5m` and require `count_over_time(dcgm_up{job=\"dcgm-exporter\",region=\"us-west1\"}[5m]) < 1` AND `sum(dcgm_up{job=\"dcgm-exporter\",region=\"us-west1\"} == 0) > 1` to avoid single-node noise. also add severity: warning for transient, page for critical when >3 nodes.

maya: i'll run the rollout in ~10m. assigning tasks: @maya to do the DaemonSet change and rollout, @sam to update the prometheus rule and grafana panel, @jordan to validate the image pipeline and fix the image.

alex: small follow-up: we should surface node image label in Grafana so we can quickly correlate missing metrics with images. relabel suggestion: add metric relabel to include `node_label_image` from node_exporter or via prometheus relabel_config. filing ticket INFRA-4282.

sam: noted, i will add that to the sprint and add a Grafana annotation for the rollout window.

alex: will post results after rollout. if anyone sees pager for DCGMExporterDown after the change, tag this thread.

maya: rollout done — initial verification: pods now pend on bad hosts (init failed) and healthy hosts are serving metrics. dashboards show GPU metrics returning for the cluster. will follow up with list of affected hosts and image fix.

alex: thanks all — closing thread once image pipeline is fixed and INFRA-4282 is tracked.
